## Customer problem

What should a traveler or operator be able to do?

## Change and scope

What changed, and what deliberately did not?

## Evidence

List each exact test command and its actual result. Include the current
revision and relevant workflow run when available. State what was not run.

## Failure and recovery

Which boundary or changed condition did you check? How can the owner recover
without discarding unrelated work?

## Review

- [ ] I inspected the actual diff.
- [ ] No real passenger data, credentials or customer information is included.
- [ ] Evidence distinguishes local tests from hosted checks and approval.
